query_snapshot: Which protective-clothing barrier materials does the archived NIOSH table list as providing an 8-hour rating for acetone, and what caveat should accompany use of that list?
final_answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- The archived NIOSH TABLE A lists Butyl as providing an 8-hour rating for acetone. [NIOSH Recommendations for Chemical Protective Clothing A-Z | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/ncpc/azncpc.html]
- The archived NIOSH TABLE A lists PE/EVAL as providing an 8-hour rating for acetone. [NIOSH Recommendations for Chemical Protective Clothing A-Z | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/ncpc/azncpc.html]
- The archived NIOSH TABLE A lists Barricade as providing an 8-hour rating for acetone. [NIOSH Recommendations for Chemical Protective Clothing A-Z | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/ncpc/azncpc.html]
- The archived NIOSH TABLE A lists CPF3 as providing an 8-hour rating for acetone. [NIOSH Recommendations for Chemical Protective Clothing A-Z | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/ncpc/azncpc.html]
- The archived NIOSH TABLE A lists Responder as providing an 8-hour rating for acetone. [NIOSH Recommendations for Chemical Protective Clothing A-Z | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/ncpc/azncpc.html]
- The archived NIOSH TABLE A lists Trellchem as providing an 8-hour rating for acetone. [NIOSH Recommendations for Chemical Protective Clothing A-Z | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/ncpc/azncpc.html]
- The archived NIOSH TABLE A lists Tychem as providing an 8-hour rating for acetone. [NIOSH Recommendations for Chemical Protective Clothing A-Z | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/ncpc/azncpc.html]
- The archived NIOSH recommendations table is a contractor product and its contents 'do not necessarily reflect NIOSH policy' (i.e., the table is guidance, not an absolute NIOSH specification). [NIOSH Recommendations for Chemical Protective Clothing A-Z | NIOSH | CDC: https://archive.cdc.gov/www_cdc_gov/niosh/ncpc/azncpc.html]
- Permeation and protective performance depend strongly on conditions such as temperature, chemical concentration, mixtures, contact duration, and barrier thickness. [OSHA Technical Manual (OTM) - Section VIII: Chapter 1 | Occupational Safety and Health Administration: http://www.osha.gov/otm/section-8-ppe/chapter-1; Protective Clothing and Ensembles | NIOSH: https://restoredcdc.org/www.cdc.gov/niosh/topics/protclothing/default.html]
- No material protects against all chemicals or prolonged exposure (i.e., chemicals will eventually permeate protective clothing under some conditions). [OSHA Technical Manual (OTM) - Section VIII: Chapter 1 | Occupational Safety and Health Administration: http://www.osha.gov/otm/section-8-ppe/chapter-1]
